title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 5
text:
Limits and Deductibles Descriptions
Location Coverage Level
Applied separately to each coverage:
• Building
• Contents
• Time Element / BI
Options available:
• Separate limits and 
deductibles per coverage
• Combined coverage limit 
(Building + Contents 
together)
• Combined coverage 
deductible (Building + 
Contents together)
Important:
• Combined limit does NOT 
require combined deductible
User may choose:
• Combined limit + separate 
deductibles
• Separate limits + combined 
deductible
Location (Site) Level
Limits and deductibles apply to all coverages at a 
single location
Covers:
• Building
• Contents
• Time Element
Overrides individual coverage totals if more 
restrictive
Policy Level (Policy Layer)
Applies to all locations under the policy
Can be defined for:
• Building policy coverage (Cover A & B)
• Contents policy coverage (Cover C)
• Time Element / BI policy coverage (Cover D)
Policy-level structures may include:
• Blanket limits
• Blanket deductibles
• Coverage-specific policy limits
Blanket Limits & Deductibles
Blanket limit → Applies to the entire policy
Blanket deductible → Applies to combined losses across all locations
Additional controls:
• Minimum deductible (floor)
• Maximum deductible (cap)
Purpose:
• Control the total effect of multiple location deductibles
